2025 
Author: Rajesh Bindal
Bench: Rajesh Bindal
 1
 In The Supreme Court Of India
 Criminal Appellate Jurisdiction
 Criminal Appeal No.1457 Of 2017
 Rizwana Anjum @ Eram Fatima Appell
 Versus
 Sarwar Nehal Rizvi & Ors. Respon
 O R D E R
1.
We have heard the learned counsel appearing for the appellant.
Despite the service of notice, none appears for the respondents.

2. The present appeal has been filed by the appellant- complainant aggrieved by the judgment of the High court, whereby the High court has quashed the chargesheet filed against respondent Nos. 1-4 in a case arising out of Crime No. 581/2016, under Sections 419, 420, 467, 468, 471 of the Indian Penal code, 1860.

3. While we are not inclined to interfere with the impugned judgment, particularly in light of the suit pendente-lite before the Civil Court, we direct the Civil Judge, Jr. Division, Utraula, Balrampur to dispose of the pending suit, bearing O.S. No.339/2016, within a period of nine months from today.
